run_FineTuner_fine_tune_and_evaluate: run FineTuner.fine_tune_and_evaluate to fine-tune a global model on all client datasets and report metrics
run_FineTuner_fine_tune_model: run FineTuner.fine_tune_model to fine-tune a global model on a single client's data and return the personalized model
create_FineTuner_eval_client: create an eval client from a ClientConfig using Hydra instantiate to prepare for model fine-tuning and evaluation
review_FineTuner_copy_and_train_model: review the FineTuner workflow that calls copy_and_train_model on an eval client to produce a fine-tuned model
summarize_FineTuner_metrics_reporting: summarize how FineTuner.fine_tune_and_evaluate reports metrics via IFLMetricsReporter after fine-tuning all clients
